thread:
Maya Chen: Morning! Quick idea — Breakfast Burrito Caravan this Friday? We set up on the 6th-floor common table, people bring/collect burritos in shifts so it's warm and low effort. :tada: :taco:
Samir Patel: love it. count me in. what time? :raised_hands:
Ava Lopez: yum. can we make sure there's a vegetarian option? and gf if possible.
Diego R.: I can swing by La Mision and pick up a batch if folks chip in. how many approx?
Zoe Kim: I'll bring two jars of fresh salsa verde and napkins.
Jamie Park: can we do 9:45 — gives parents time to drop kids and come up?
Maya Chen: 9:45 works for me. planning for ~20 people? say 25 to be safe.
Samir Patel: +1 on 25. i'm happy to Venmo for pickup — how much should we plan per person?
Diego R.: La Mision breakfast burritos are ~8.50 each. so $9 cover + tip = $225 for 25. split 9 ways-ish?
Ava Lopez: I can cover $30 today and folks can pay me back. also bringing 3 tofu burritos for veg option.
Maya Chen: can we do a tiny sign-up so we don't accidentally get 20 carnitas? propose format:
```
Name — qty — preference (eg: carnitas/vegan/eggs) — payment (venmo/@handle)
```
Samir Patel: Samir — 2 — eggs + carnitas — venmo @sampi
Zoe Kim: Zoe — 1 — salsa only (i'm on cleanup) — venmo @zoek
Jamie Park: Jamie — 1 — gluten-free — i'll Venmo on Friday AM
Diego R.: Diego — pickup volunteer — will post ETA when I leave the shop
Maya Chen: @lunchbot can you add a quick RSVP tally and reminder for Friday 8am? :pray:
lunchbot: RSVP recorded: 6 participants. Reminder scheduled for 2025-11-07T08:00:00Z.
Ava Lopez: also tiny ask — we have a plant watering volunteer? the basil by the pantry is thirsty. :seedling:
Samir Patel: i can water it after lunch.
Jamie Park: bringing disposable plates? or should we use kitchen?
Zoe Kim: I'll bring a stack of compostable plates and forks.
Maya Chen: perfect. last thing — if anyone's bringing kids, we can stash an extra burrito in the fridge for later. label name/time.
Diego R.: I'll grab extra napkins and salsa packets just in case. leaving at 9:05 to pick up.
Samir Patel: thanks everyone! excited. :taco: :coffee:
Maya Chen: thanks team — see you Friday 9:45 on 6th floor.
